name: Lorois

attributes.attribute: met a train of women in the woods

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Lorois is a young knight of Camelot in Arthurian legend. One day he rode through the woods and met a host of mounted women. The first rank held noble ladies with flowers in their hair, riding with their lovers on strong horses. Behind that party came a dismal trail: a hundred thin women in black robes on bony mounts, and thunder and snow went with them. A hundred pale men followed at a distance. The first women had given their hearts to love, while the second had refused it.

okr.objective: Tell the wood may the knight Lorois confronted.
key_results: Lorois is a young knight drawn from Camelot.
In the woods he met a crowd of women on horses.
The first train had accepted love; the second had cut it off.
